import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

MAX_LIMIT = 510

def range_sum(start, end):
    return (start + end) * (end - start + 1) // 2

def add_modulo(a, b, mod):
    s = a + b
    if s >= mod:
        s -= mod
    return s

def make_pair(first, second):
    return (first, second)

def pair_add(a, b, mod):
    return (add_modulo(a[0], b[0], mod), add_modulo(a[1], b[1], mod))

def pair_multiply(a, b, mod):
    first_part = (a[0] * b[0]) % mod
    second_part = (a[0] * b[1] + a[1] * b[0]) % mod
    return (first_part, second_part)

def main():
    data = list(map(int, input().split()))
    totalN, totalM, modVal = data[0], data[1], data[2]
    comb = [[0] * (MAX_LIMIT) for _ in range(MAX_LIMIT)]
    dpTable = [[(0, 0) for _ in range(MAX_LIMIT)] for _ in range(MAX_LIMIT)]
    for i in range(MAX_LIMIT):
        comb[i][0] = 1
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            comb[i][j] = add_modulo(comb[i - 1][j], comb[i - 1][j - 1], modVal)
    for i in range(totalN + 1):
        dpTable[i][0] = make_pair(1, 0)
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            if j > totalM:
                break
            if i != j:
                for k in range(1, i + 1):
                    if k - 1 >= 0:
                        t = pair_multiply(dpTable[k - 1][k - 1], dpTable[i - k][j - k + 1], modVal)
                        combi = make_pair(comb[j][k - 1], 0)
                        t2 = pair_multiply(t, combi, modVal)
                        dpTable[i][j] = pair_add(dpTable[i][j], t2, modVal)
            else:
                for k in range(1, i + 1):
                    t1 = dpTable[k - 1][k - 1]
                    t2 = dpTable[i - k][i - k]
                    combi = make_pair(comb[i - 1][k - 1], 0)
                    factor = i + 1 - range_sum(1, k) + range_sum(k + 1, i) - k * (i - k)
                    factor_pair = (factor, 0)
                    t = pair_multiply(t1, t2, modVal)
                    t = pair_multiply(t, combi, modVal)
                    t = pair_multiply(t, factor_pair, modVal)
                    dpTable[i][j] = pair_add(dpTable[i][j], t, modVal)
    print(dpTable[totalN][totalM][1])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
